Established in 1997, the Honors College at Rutgers-Camden is a community of students drawn from all three undergraduate schools on
campus: the College of Arts and Sciences, the School of Business, and the School of Nursing. It represents an investment in those whom
the university expects to be its strongest students, whether they arrive at Rutgers at the start of college, join us after a year here, or
transfer from another institution. Our aims are to support academic achievement, encourage engagement in campus life and in larger
communities, and create a learning environment in which students feel at home.
